yt.title: Every card shuffle in history is probably unique #Shorts
yt.description:
52! = 52 x 51 x ... x 1, computed exactly: {c_sci} (a {c_digits}-digit number). Assumes a fair shuffle.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Shuffle a deck of cards properly, and you have almost certainly made an order that has never existed before.

scenes.label: ways to order 52 cards
scenes.narration: There are fifty two factorial possible orders. That number has {c_digits_say} digits. It is about {c_m_say} times ten to the power of {c_e_say}.
Even if every person alive shuffled once a second since the Big Bang, we would cover a tiny fraction of them.
